operations.contract: Own builder and bounded continuation stack, borrow external immutable source/tokens, own ephemeral CSS/reference caches borrowing same external data. No self reference. Cancellation invalidates draft and outstanding tickets.
operations.actual_api: Decoder::new/from_source; step_production(q, required DecoderProductionOperations, same RasterJob, control) -> TraversalDecodeEvent; resume_pattern_production; finish_decoded -> actual HiddenScene/Drawable. Legacy DecodeSession/step and step_traversal are explicit compatibility. No pending-child animation fabrication.

operations.name: Decoder::resume_pattern
operations.signature: fn resume_pattern(&mut self, ticket: PatternTicket, result: Result<Tile>, control: &mut dyn WorkControl) -> Result<()>
operations.contract: After request view borrow ends, validate ticket/dimensions/capacity; move rendered pixels once into pattern; update cache/budget then continue same position. Error aborts job, no fallback or skipping. Nested patterns finish before parent event.
operations.actual_api: Decoder::new/from_source; step_production(q, required DecoderProductionOperations, same RasterJob, control) -> TraversalDecodeEvent; resume_pattern_production; finish_decoded -> actual HiddenScene/Drawable.
